outcome.text: He holds the stone and says, out loud, that he would have known the name. The scratches in the stone seem, for a moment, shallower.
"Come back," he says. "Often. I shall need people who have been underneath it."

scenes.title: King Aldric
scenes.body: The throne room doors close behind you, and for once nobody is listening at them.

scenes.title: Bren Cask
scenes.body: The guard looks up from her ale and takes the measure of you in one long look: weapons first, boots second, faces last. "If you're selling, I'm skint. If you're hiring, sit down."

options.label: Ask what she is doing here
options.say: You look like you're waiting for something.

outcome.text: "For the road to open, same as everybody. I came in off it." She turns the cup. "Three wagons out of Valorheim, and me to guard them. I'm what's left of the job."

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: We could use a sword. Would you come?

outcome.text: "Would I." She is already reaching for the greatsword. "I'd rather be paid to go looking for whatever took my wagons than sit here waiting for it to come and finish the job."
She goes back to making the ale last.

scenes.title: Bren Cask
scenes.body: Bren waits, cup in hand.

options.label: Ask what happened to the caravan
options.say: What took the wagons?

outcome.text: "Something came out of the trees at dusk. Thin, grey, moving like puppets with half the strings cut." She drinks. "I cut one in half. It kept coming. Both halves."

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: We could use a sword. Would you come?

outcome.text: "Would I." She is already reaching for the greatsword. "I'd rather be paid to go looking for whatever took my wagons than sit here waiting for it to come and finish the job."
She goes back to making the ale last.

scenes.title: Bren Cask
scenes.body: Bren raises her cup an inch, which seems to be hello.

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: We could use a sword. Would you come?

outcome.text: "Would I." She is already reaching for the greatsword. "I'd rather be paid to go looking for whatever took my wagons than sit here waiting for it to come and finish the job."
They wait for you to go on.
She goes back to making the ale last.

scenes.title: Bren Cask
scenes.body: She goes back to making the ale last.

scenes.title: Tamsin Reed
scenes.body: The elf does not look up from her snare. "Quietly," she says. "Not that there's anything left in there to scare."

options.label: Ask what she hunts
options.say: What are you setting snares for?

outcome.text: "Deer, once. Hare. Anything that ate." She holds up the snare: leaves, and a twig. "A month of this. I've started setting them for whatever is eating the deer."

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: You know the wood. Would you walk it with us?

outcome.text: "Every deer path from here to the Hollow Grove." She strings the bow in one movement. "And I can put an arrow through a thrall's eye at sixty paces. Which is more use than a snare, this month."
She goes back to the snare.

scenes.title: Tamsin Reed
scenes.body: Tamsin waits, eyes on the treeline.

options.label: Ask what has happened to the game
options.say: Where have the deer gone?

outcome.text: "Gone. Not hunted out: gone." She looks at the trees. "Everything in that wood with the sense to run from something has run. Which tells you what the ones left in there have the sense for."

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: You know the wood. Would you walk it with us?

outcome.text: "Every deer path from here to the Hollow Grove." She strings the bow in one movement. "And I can put an arrow through a thrall's eye at sixty paces. Which is more use than a snare, this month."
She goes back to the snare.

scenes.title: Tamsin Reed
scenes.body: Tamsin lifts two fingers from the bow. You are seen.

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: You know the wood. Would you walk it with us?

outcome.text: "Every deer path from here to the Hollow Grove." She strings the bow in one movement. "And I can put an arrow through a thrall's eye at sixty paces. Which is more use than a snare, this month."
They wait for you to go on.
She goes back to the snare.

scenes.title: Tamsin Reed
scenes.body: She goes back to the snare.

scenes.title: Sister Wren
scenes.body: The young sister sits back on her heels and pushes her hair out of her eyes with a wet wrist. "Ashkyr keep you. Mind the wet step. I've scrubbed it three times this morning; it is the cleanest step in the valley and nobody is coming up it."

options.label: Ask why nobody comes
options.say: Nobody comes to the temple?

outcome.text: "The hurt come to the temple. That's what Brother Aldus says." She wrings the cloth out. "They're not coming. They're lying out on the roads, and I'm in here scrubbing."

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: Then come where the hurt are. Come with us.

outcome.text: "Fifteen gold for the poor box," she says at once, as if she had the sum ready, "and I'll come and keep you standing. I can mend most things that bleed." She looks at the step. "Somebody else can scrub it."
She goes back to the cleanest step in the valley.

scenes.title: Sister Wren
scenes.body: Wren waits, cloth in hand.

options.label: Ask about Brother Aldus
options.say: How is Brother Aldus?

outcome.text: "Tired." She lowers her voice. "He hasn't slept properly since the Whitmore girl went missing. He sits up with the old books, the ones about seals, and he doesn't like me asking which."

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: Then come where the hurt are. Come with us.

outcome.text: "Fifteen gold for the poor box," she says at once, as if she had the sum ready, "and I'll come and keep you standing. I can mend most things that bleed." She looks at the step. "Somebody else can scrub it."
She goes back to the cleanest step in the valley.

scenes.title: Sister Wren
scenes.body: Sister Wren looks up from the step with something like hope.

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: Then come where the hurt are. Come with us.

outcome.text: "Fifteen gold for the poor box," she says at once, as if she had the sum ready, "and I'll come and keep you standing. I can mend most things that bleed." She looks at the step. "Somebody else can scrub it."
They wait for you to go on.
She goes back to the cleanest step in the valley.

scenes.title: Sister Wren
scenes.body: She goes back to the cleanest step in the valley.

scenes.title: Ilse Marrow
scenes.body: The woman at the copying desk finishes her sentence before she looks up, and it is clearly a sentence she has enjoyed. "If you want a book, ask the Keeper. If you want an argument, I'm free."

options.label: Ask what she is writing
options.say: What are you writing?

outcome.text: "A letter to the Academy explaining why they should have me back." She blots it. "They threw me out for setting fire to a lecturer. In fairness to me, he asked what the spell did."

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: Copying is wasted on you. Come with us.

outcome.text: "Finally, somebody with sense." She caps the ink. "Sixty gold, and you'll have somebody along who has actually read what you are about to get yourselves killed over. I also do fireballs."
She goes back to the letter, and the letter gets ruder.

scenes.title: Ilse Marrow
scenes.body: Ilse taps her pen, waiting.

options.label: Ask about the library
options.say: Anything strange in the stacks lately?

outcome.text: "Somebody has been borrowing the books on the old seals and bringing them back with pages cut out. Cleanly. With a knife that knew what it was doing." She sniffs. "I told the Keeper. The Keeper told me to mind my own copying."

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: Copying is wasted on you. Come with us.

outcome.text: "Finally, somebody with sense." She caps the ink. "Sixty gold, and you'll have somebody along who has actually read what you are about to get yourselves killed over. I also do fireballs."
She goes back to the letter, and the letter gets ruder.

scenes.title: Ilse Marrow
scenes.body: Ilse looks up from her letter. "Oh, good. You."

options.label: Ask her to join you
options.say: Copying is wasted on you. Come with us.

outcome.text: "Finally, somebody with sense." She caps the ink. "Sixty gold, and you'll have somebody along who has actually read what you are about to get yourselves killed over. I also do fireballs."
They wait for you to go on.
She goes back to the letter, and the letter gets ruder.

scenes.title: Ilse Marrow
scenes.body: She goes back to the letter, and the letter gets ruder.

scenes.title: Grum
scenes.body: The dwarf does not get up. He does not look as if he gets up for anybody. "Shaft's shut," he says. "Foreman's orders. Foreman's wrong."

options.label: Ask why the shaft is shut
options.say: Why did they shut it?

outcome.text: "They put a guard on the deep workings. Then the guard stopped coming up. Now they just shut it, and pay us to sit here." He spits. "Badly."

options.label: Ask him to join you
options.say: We're going down there, sooner or later. Come with us.

outcome.text: "Forty gold." He stands, and keeps standing for longer than seems possible. "I want to hit something that deserves it."
He goes back to glaring at the shaft.

scenes.title: Grum
scenes.body: Grum waits, the axe across his knees.

options.label: Ask about the token round his neck
options.say: Whose token is that?

outcome.text: "My brother's." His thumb goes over it. "Something down there broke his pick in half. With my brother still holding it. I'm keeping his token till I can put it back on the board."

options.label: Ask him to join you
options.say: We're going down there, sooner or later. Come with us.

outcome.text: "Forty gold." He stands, and keeps standing for longer than seems possible. "I want to hit something that deserves it."
He goes back to glaring at the shaft.

scenes.title: Grum
scenes.body: Grum grunts. It might be a greeting.

options.label: Ask him to join you
options.say: We're going down there, sooner or later. Come with us.

outcome.text: "Forty gold." He stands, and keeps standing for longer than seems possible. "I want to hit something that deserves it."
They wait for you to go on.
He goes back to glaring at the shaft.

scenes.title: Grum
scenes.body: He goes back to glaring at the shaft.

scenes.title: Vey
scenes.body: The halfling at the fountain smiles at you with all of a great many teeth. "Lost something? No?" A glance at your belts. "Give it a minute."

options.label: Ask what he does
options.say: What is it you do, exactly?

outcome.text: "Doors." He spreads his hands. "Locks, mostly, and what's behind them. There's no lock in Valorheim I haven't opened, and a few I've opened twice, to be sure."

options.label: Ask him to join you
options.say: We could use somebody who opens doors.

outcome.text: "Fifty gold, and you'll have every door between here and the palace." He straightens his coat, and something in one of the pockets clinks. "Pockets too, if you're not fussy."
He melts back into the crowd round the fountain.

scenes.title: Vey
scenes.body: Vey waits, watching the crowd over your shoulder.

options.label: Ask what he has heard
options.say: You hear things. What are you hearing?

outcome.text: "The palace kitchens order twice the bread they used to." He holds up two fingers. "Twice. And nobody new has been seen going in. So who is eating it?"

options.label: Ask him to join you
options.say: We could use somebody who opens doors.

outcome.text: "Fifty gold, and you'll have every door between here and the palace." He straightens his coat, and something in one of the pockets clinks. "Pockets too, if you're not fussy."
He melts back into the crowd round the fountain.

scenes.title: Vey
scenes.body: Vey tips an imaginary hat. "My favourite customers."

options.label: Ask him to join you
options.say: We could use somebody who opens doors.

outcome.text: "Fifty gold, and you'll have every door between here and the palace." He straightens his coat, and something in one of the pockets clinks. "Pockets too, if you're not fussy."
They wait for you to go on.
He melts back into the crowd round the fountain.

scenes.title: Vey
scenes.body: He melts back into the crowd round the fountain.

scenes.title: Sergeant Ada Rook
scenes.body: A sergeant of the Watch with a ledger under one arm and a scar across both knuckles looks up from a stack of straw-packed crates. "Stores. If you're not Watch, you're paying."

options.label: Ask what is in the crates
options.say: What's in the crates, Sergeant?

outcome.text: "Alchemy. Fire, frost, acid, the lot." She pats a crate, gently. "The Captain ordered it for the wood. Then the Captain worked out what it would do to the wood. So now it's for sale."

options.label: Ask to see the stores
options.say: Show us what you've got.

outcome.text: "Sign here. And here." She opens the nearest crate and stands well back from it.
She goes back to counting crates.

scenes.title: Sergeant Ada Rook
scenes.body: Rook waits.

options.label: Ask about the Watch
options.say: How is the Watch holding up?

outcome.text: "Twelve of us for a town and a wood. Nine, since the Whitmore girl." She does not say what happened to the other three, and you do not ask.

options.label: Ask to see the stores
options.say: Show us what you've got.

outcome.text: "Sign here. And here." She opens the nearest crate and stands well back from it.

options.label: Ask if the Watch needs a hand
options.say: Anything we can do for the Watch, Sergeant?

outcome.text: "The roster." She holds up a sheet with three names struck through. "The Captain has to sign the new one, and he will not look at it. Get him to sign it. He will do it for strangers. He will not do it for me."

options.label: Give her the signed roster
options.say: Signed. He put himself on it too.

outcome.text: "Did he." She folds it very carefully. "Then we are ten."

options.label: Ask what the Watch has lost on the Mere
options.say: Has the Watch lost anything out on the Mere?

outcome.text: "A crate of frost vials." She checks the ledger. "It went in the reeds when the drowned came up at the patrol. Clear the reeds and bring it back, and it is yours to keep half of."

options.label: Give her the crate
options.say: Your crate of frost vials, Sergeant.

outcome.text: "Unbroken!" She signs it back in, and counts out coin for half. "You are wasted on adventure."
She goes back to counting crates.

scenes.title: Sergeant Ada Rook
scenes.body: Sergeant Rook looks up from the ledger. "Back for more?"

options.label: Ask to see the stores
options.say: Show us what you've got.

outcome.text: "Sign here. And here." She opens the nearest crate and stands well back from it.
A nod: go on.
She goes back to counting crates.

scenes.title: Sergeant Ada Rook
scenes.body: She goes back to counting crates.

scenes.title: Quartermaster Odile Venn
scenes.body: Behind a trestle of oiled steel under a Crown awning, a grey-haired quartermaster in a buttoned blue coat is writing prices on slates with great care. "Crown surplus," she says, without looking up. "Every piece stamped and every price fixed."

options.label: Ask why the Crown is selling
options.say: Why is the Crown selling its own arms?

outcome.text: "Because the Crown is short of coin and long on swords." She chalks a number, rubs it out, chalks a bigger one. "And because half the armoury's officers stopped coming to work, and somebody has to."

options.label: Ask to see the stock
options.say: Show us what the Crown is selling.

outcome.text: "Blades on the left, wands and staffs on the right. Do not wave the wands."
She goes back to the slates.

scenes.title: Quartermaster Odile Venn
scenes.body: Venn waits.

options.label: Ask about the palace
options.say: What's the talk at the palace?

outcome.text: "That the Queen orders nothing through my stores any more. Nothing." Her mouth goes thin. "Thirty years I have kept the palace in steel. Somebody else is keeping it in something now."

options.label: Ask to see the stock
options.say: Show us what the Crown is selling.

outcome.text: "Blades on the left, wands and staffs on the right. Do not wave the wands."

options.label: Ask what the Crown is missing
options.say: Is the Crown short of anything besides coin?

outcome.text: "Forty picks." She chalks it on a slate. "Lent to the Bloodstone mine and never returned. The mine head will have the loan ledger. Bring it, and I will have them back."

options.label: Give her the loan ledger
options.say: The mine's loan ledger.

outcome.text: "Forty." She runs a finger down the column. "And not one returned. The Crown will be writing a stern letter."

options.label: Ask about the requisitions on her slate
options.say: Those requisitions you rubbed out. Forged?

outcome.text: "Signed by a clerk who does not exist." She lowers her voice. "The Keeper at the library knows every clerk's hand in the city. Ask him whose this is."

options.label: Tell her whose hand it is
options.say: It copies the Queen's secretary's hand.

outcome.text: She sets down the chalk. "Then I will stop filling them," she says, "and I will start keeping them."

options.label: Ask what the Crown owes
options.say: Does the Crown owe anybody besides you?

outcome.text: "Millhaven." She taps a slate. "The Watch there has not been paid since spring. Ask their Captain the sum. I will see it paid, if I have to sell every sword on this table."

options.label: Tell her the sum
options.say: Two hundred and twelve gold, since spring.

outcome.text: "Then it will be two hundred and twelve gold by the next post." She writes it on the slate and underlines it twice.

options.label: Ask about the patrol she sent into the Rift
options.say: Did the Crown send anybody into the Rift?

outcome.text: "Six from the armoury, the night it opened." Her hands are still. "I signed their kit out myself. If you go down, bring back a tag. Any tag."

options.label: Give her the tag
options.say: Tag forty-one, from the lip of the Rift.

outcome.text: "Forty-one. Corporal Asha Venn." She closes her hand on it. "My niece," she says, when she can.

options.label: Ask what the Crown wants from the Quiet Court
options.say: Is there anything in the Quiet Court the Crown would want?

outcome.text: "The iron crowns the courtiers wear." She has gone pale. "They were made in our armoury, eight hundred years ago. I want one back on the inventory, so I can strike it off."

options.label: Give her the iron crown
options.say: A courtier's crown, from the Quiet Court.

outcome.text: She checks the stamp against a ledger older than she is, then draws a single line through an entry. "Returned," she says. "At last."
She goes back to the slates.

scenes.title: Quartermaster Odile Venn
scenes.body: Quartermaster Venn looks up from her slates. "Again? Good."

options.label: Ask to see the stock
options.say: Show us what the Crown is selling.

outcome.text: "Blades on the left, wands and staffs on the right. Do not wave the wands."
A nod: go on.
She goes back to the slates.

scenes.title: Quartermaster Odile Venn
scenes.body: She goes back to the slates.
